game_time: Once per game, the warlord and any attached unit gains the Rending (5+) special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.

groups.label: An Eldar Farseer knows all of the Psychic powers from the Runes of Fate Discipline:
groups.printed: An Eldar Farseer knows all of the Psychic powers from the Runes of Fate Discipline:
groups.name: Runes of Fate Psychic Powers

choices.name: Doom
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 24" of the Psyker. All friendly Eldar units may re-roll to wound rolls and penetration rolls against that target until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Eldritch Storm
choices.text:
When this Power is Cast, select one of the following effects:

1. Place a Storm Token within 18" of the Caster.
2. Move a Storm Token on the battlefield 2D6".

At the end of the Caster's Shooting Phase, or at the end of opponent's Movement Phase, all enemy units within 5" of the Storm Token take D6, Strength 6, AP4 Automatic Hits. Wounds and Saves are made as normal.

Only 1 Storm Token can be placed on the battlefield. If the Caster attempts to place a new Storm Token using this Psychic Power, the previous token is removed and no longer in effect.

choices.name: Executioner
choices.text:
A Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic weapon:

- Executioner

choices.name: Fortune
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24" of the Psyker. That unit gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Guide
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24" of the Psyker. That unit may re-roll all to hit rolls until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Mind War
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single enemy model within 24" of the Psyker. The target model must make a Leadership test. On a pass, the target model takes 1 Automatic Wound with no saves allowed. If the target failed, they take D3+1 Automatic Wounds instead with no saves allowed.

groups.label: An Eldar Warlock may purchase Psychic powers from the Runes of Battle Discipline:
groups.printed: An Eldar Warlock may purchase Psychic powers from the Runes of Battle Discipline:
groups.name: Runes of Battle Psychic Powers

choices.name: Conceal
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Destructor
choices.text:
A Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic weapon:

- Destructor

choices.name: Drain
choices.text: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target suffers -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Embolden
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit automatically pass Pinning and Panic tests until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Empower
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Enervate
choices.text: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target suffers -1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Enhance
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Horrify
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Fear (3) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Reveal
choices.text: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24" of the Psyker. The target unit cannot claim Cover Saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Eldar unit in your army which gains access to the Runes of Fate Psychic Discipline instead must purchase the Psychic Powers listed on the Revenant Discipline (see below).
groups.printed: Any Eldar unit in your army which gains access to the Runes of Fate Psychic Discipline instead must purchase the Psychic Powers listed on the Revenant Discipline (see below).
groups.name: Revenant Discipline

choices.name: Ancestors Grace
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24" of the Psyker. That unit counts as gaining the benefit of the Strength from Death special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase even if no units were slain and removed from play this turn.

choices.name: Shield of Ynnead
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain a 4+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Storm of Whispers
choices.text:
A Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic weapon:

- Storm of Whispers

choices.name: Word of the Phoenix
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly Infantry, Automata or Monster unit within 24" of the Psyker. One model in the target unit heals 1 wound. If the unit has no wounds to be healed, the unit regains 1 lost model with 1 wound remaining.
